# datadog_feature_flag_environment_config (Resource)

Controls a feature flag's enabled state in one environment. Deleting this resource disables the flag; it does not delete the flag or environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "datadog_feature_flag" "checkout" {
  key                 = "checkout-redesign"
  name                = "Checkout redesign"
  value_type          = "BOOLEAN"
  default_variant_key = "off"
  variants = [
    { key = "off", name = "Off", value = "false" },
    { key = "on", name = "On", value = "true" },
  ]
}

resource "datadog_feature_flag_environment" "production" {
  name    = "Production"
  queries = ["env:production"]
}

resource "datadog_feature_flag_environment_config" "checkout_production" {
  feature_flag_id = datadog_feature_flag.checkout.id
  environment_id  = datadog_feature_flag_environment.production.id
  enabled         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the flag is enabled in this environment.
- `environment_id` (String) UUID of the feature flag environment.
- `feature_flag_id` (String) UUID of the feature flag.

### Read-Only

- `default_variant_id` (String) UUID of the environment's default variant. The public API exposes this value on reads but has no operation to change it.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `status` (String) Status returned by Datadog: ENABLED or DISABLED.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import datadog_feature_flag_environment_config.checkout_production "11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111:22222222-2222-2222-2222-222222222222"
```
